description: This file defines the main application widget for a Flutter news app, including theme setup, routing, and a biometric authentication gate that runs on app launch.

classes.description: Root widget of the application, setting theme and navigation routes.

classes.description: State class managing biometric authentication logic and UI during app launch.

classes.description: Screen displayed for navigation errors or missing route data.
